title: Opt-in stage receipts and failure-preserving aggregate

objective.statement: Integrate stage-local checked work, nonlinear remainder, RHS geometry, token identity, and explicit failure receipts into the receipt-only sequential path.
objective.observable_success: Every attempted stage has a validated receipt and every complete step has exactly eight unique stage identities; production callers are untouched.
non_goals: Changing scientific tolerances or expected outputs

P0_failure_modes.trigger: A stage failure returns before emitting ERROR receipt with preserved counters.

required_detection.test: injected stage failure preserves prior COMPLETE and current ERROR

P0_failure_modes.trigger: Telemetry remainder JVP is uncounted or folded into linear work.

P1_failure_modes.trigger: RHS SVD duplicates the standalone prototype rather than using canonical faer machinery.

forbidden_changes: Do not change reference tolerances or expected scientific outputs to make tests pass.
Do not guess across a scientific or numerical specification boundary.
Do not suppress failed stages, cells, tests, or Atlassian drift.

invariants.statement: All attempted stages are explicit and complete steps contain 0..7 exactly once.
Nonlinear remainder equation map is exact.
Geometry metrics are scale-invariant and non-tautological.
